The main takeaway from our work is that
the stability of the non-linear closed loop system is guaranteed by the existence of a hybrid Lyapunov-like function, which can be used to evaluate a hybrid cost functional.

the hybrid optimal control problem for non linear impulse dynamical systems can be solved in closed form as a hybrid optimal control problem involving an underlying hybrid Hamilton Jacobi-Bellman equation.

the hybrid optimal control problem can be reduced to an unconstrained, convex, non linear, non quadratic programming problem, which can be solved using standard nonlinear programming methods, and which does not require any knowledge of the system dynamics.
